resolve: n=$(printf %s "$FACTORY_INPUT" | sed -e "s|^[[:space:]]*||" -e "s|[[:space:]]*$||" | sed -n -e "s|^#\{0,1\}\([0-9][0-9]*\)$|\1|p" -e "s|^https://github.com/jasoncarreira/mimir/issues/\([0-9][0-9]*\)$|\1|p"); [ -n "$n" ] || exit 0; kind=$(gh api "repos/jasoncarreira/mimir/issues/$n" --jq 'if .pull_request then "pr" else "issue" end') || exit 1; [ "$kind" = "issue" ] || exit 0; gh issue view "$n" --repo jasoncarreira/mimir --json number,title,body,url,state,labels,assignees --jq '{run_id:(.number|tostring)} + .'
